info.title: Command Center shared data layer
info.description: Read-only contract for the Swarm Watch Command Center. Hive and Project Cockpit both import one board data module and read this payload, so projects, live agents, and needs-you counts resolve to identical values in both views. Every number carries a visible label, a ledger source field, and a hover explanation. Numbers without a trusted source are omitted from the payload and from the DOM. Owner actions are out of scope and remain in contracts/watch-s4-ops.json.

servers.description: The loopback board server, optionally published through Tailscale Serve

x-accuracy-tolerance.description: A displayed figure that disagrees with the ledger by more than one ticket or $0.01 spend fails CI with a non-zero exit.

x-shared-module.name: board data module
x-shared-module.description: Both views must resolve identical values for projects, agents live, and needs-you counts from this snapshot.

get.summary: Get the shared Command Center snapshot

parameters.name: local
parameters.description: Limits data to this machine. Never enables owner routes.

200.description: Shared snapshot used by Hive and Project Cockpit

get.summary: Compare displayed figures with the ledger
get.description: Used by CI accuracy tests. Each check compares a displayed figure with its ledger value using the x-accuracy-tolerance limits.

boardTokenHeader.name: x-watch-token
boardTokenHeader.description: Board token sent as the x-watch-token request header. The t query parameter is not accepted on /api routes.

LabelledNumber.description: A rendered number. It must carry a label and a source; a number without a trusted source is omitted rather than rendered.

source.description: Ledger field path the value was read from

explanation.description: Hover text that cites the source field

stats.description: Stat strip values shared by Hive and Cockpit. Omitted keys are not rendered.

passed.description: False when any check exceeds tolerance; CI exits non-zero.

Unauthorized.description: The board token is missing or invalid.
